<function name="GetDeploySpeed" parent="Weapon" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the weapon deploy speed, as set by <page>Weapon:SetDeploySpeed</page>. If not previously set, the value will be polled from the `sv_defaultdeployspeed` <page>ConVar</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2023.06.28</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="speed" type="number">The value to set deploy speed to.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
